item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree to Adopt Audit Report on Special Inspector Choi Gil-soo on the 22nd (여야, 최길수 특별감찰관 청문보고서 22일 채택 합의)
item.description:
On the 19th, the ruling and opposition parties agreed to adopt the personnel hearing progress report on Special Inspector Choi Gil-soo. This comes about a month after the candidate's personnel hearing was held on the 18th of last month. (여야가 19일 최길수 특별감찰관에 대한 인사청문경과보고서를 채택하기로 합의했다. 지난달 18일 최 후보자의 인사청문회를 실시한 지 약 한 달 만이다.)

The office of Rep. Kim Eui-kyeom, the Democratic Party of Korea's secretary on the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, announced in a notice that day, "It has been agreed between the ruling and opposition party secretaries that at the plenary meeting to be held on the 22nd during the National Audit of the Public Prosecutors' Office, the personnel hearing progress report on Special Inspector Choi will be adopted with both qualified and unqualified opinions stated." (국회 법제사법위원회 더불어민주당 간사인 김의겸 의원실은 이날 공지를 통해 “오는 22일 공소청 국정감사 중 전체회의를 열고 최 특별감찰관에 대한 인사청문경과보고서에 적격의견과 부적격의견을 병기해 채택하기로 여야 간사 간 합의했다”고 밝혔다.)

The personnel hearing for candidate Choi was held on the 18th of last month, but as the Legislation and Judiciary Committee did not adopt the report for over a month, President Lee Jae-myung's appointment of candidate Choi has also been delayed. The Democratic Party claimed that the People Power Party was uncooperative, including refusing to agree to the adoption of the report, while the People Power Party rebutted that it had only insisted on stating unqualified opinions together and had never opposed the adoption. (최 후보자 인사청문회는 지난달 18일 이뤄졌으나, 법사위가 한 달 넘게 보고서를 채택하지 않으면서 이재명 대통령의 최 후보자 임명도 미뤄져 왔다. 민주당은 국민의힘이 보고서 채택에 동의를 하지 않는 등 비협조적이라고 주장했고, 국민의힘은 부적격 의견을 병기하자고 주장했을 뿐 채택을 반대한 적이 없다고 반박했다.)

In this regard, at the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee's National Audit of the Seoul Metropolitan Public Prosecutors' Office and others that day, the ruling and opposition parties continued to clash over the adoption of the personnel hearing progress report on Special Inspector Choi. (이와 관련해 이날 국회 법사위의 서울광역공소청 등에 대한 국정감사장에서는 최 특감 인사청문경과보고서 채택을 두고 여야 공방이 이어졌다.)

People Power Party Rep. Joo Jin-woo said, "Many people within the Democratic Party also opposed Kim Ji-yong as head of the Central Investigation Office, yet qualified and unqualified opinions were attached equally, the audit report was adopted right away, and he was appointed that very day as if they had been waiting for it—so why is the Special Inspector not being appointed?" Seo Young-kyo, the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairwoman belonging to the Democratic Party, rebutted to the effect that it was because People Power Party lawmakers had been absent from the meeting. (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 “김지용 중수청장은 민주당 내에서도 여러 사람이 반대하는데 적격 의견과 부적격 의견을 똑같이 달아 바로 감사 보고서를 채택하고 기다렸다는 듯이 그날로 임명했는데 특별감찰관은 왜 임명을 안 하느냐”고 했다. 민주당 소속인 서영교 법사위원장은 국민의힘 의원들의 회의 불출석 때문이었다는 취지로 반박했다.)

In response, People Power Party Rep. Park Hyung-soo, the opposition secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, said, "We told them to attach unqualified opinions and pass it, and we even explained the reason for attaching the unqualified opinions," adding, "We went so far as to say that and told them to pass it that day—so wasn't it the Democratic Party that didn't let it pass?" (이에 법사위 야당 간사인 국민의힘 박형수 의원은 “우리는 부적격 의견을 달고 통과시켜라 (하며) 부적격 의견을 다는 이유까지도 설명해줬다”며 “이렇게까지 얘기하면서 그날 통과시키라고 했는데 (민주당에서) 통과를 안 시킨 것 아니냐”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee Jae-myung said that day regarding the Special Inspector, "I kept requesting that the appointment be made quickly, but they say the opposition party is opposed." The President made these remarks at a press conference held at the Chunchugwan at the presidential office that day, saying, "I was of the thinking, if the opposition party is opposed, do we really have to do it, but even so, I have instructed them to look into whether there is a way to do it nonetheless." (한편 이재명 대통령은 이날 특별감찰관에 대해 “저는 빨리 임명하는 게 좋겠다고 계속 요청했는데 야당이 반대한다고 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 가진 기자 간담회에서 “야당이 반대하는데 굳이 (임명을) 해야되나 그런 생각이었는데, 그럼에도 불구하고 할 수 있는 방법이 없나 알아보라고 해놓은 상태”라며 이같이 말했다.)

If the adoption of the personnel hearing progress report is resolved at the National Assembly on the 22nd as scheduled and the President appoints through subsequent procedures, the Special Inspector will be active for the first time in about 10 years. The Special Inspector position was introduced in 2014 when the related law passed led by the Democratic Party, but had been vacant for 10 years since Special Inspector Lee Seok-soo of the Park Geun-hye administration resigned. The Special Inspector is a position that inspects for misconduct by the President's spouse and relatives within four degrees of kinship, and by senior public officials at the level of senior presidential secretaries or higher at the presidential office. (예정대로 22일 국회에서 인사청문경과보고서 채택이 의결돼 이후 절차를 거쳐 대통령이 임명하게 되면 약 10년 만에 특별감찰관이 활동하게 된다. 특별감찰관은 2014년 민주당 주도로 관련법이 통과되며 도입됐지만 박근혜 정부 이석수 특별감찰관 사임 이후 10년간 공석이었다. 특별감찰관은 대통령의 배우자와 4촌 이내 친족, 청와대 수석비서관 이상 고위 공직자의 비위를 감찰하는 자리다.)

item.title: PPP Files Complaint Against Woo Sang-ho for Spreading False Claims on 'Attracting Gangneung AI Center' (국힘, 우상호 ‘강릉 AI센터 유치’ 발언 허위사실 유포 혐의 고발)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) has filed a complaint against Gangwon Province Governor Woo Sang-ho on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act. The claim is that Governor Woo publicly announced false information during the June 3 local elections, stating that "the attraction of an artificial intelligence (AI) data center to Gangneung has been confirmed." (국민의힘이 우상호 강원도지사를 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 고발했다. 우 지사가 6·3 지방선거 당시 “강릉 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 유치를 확정했다”고 허위사실을 공표했다는 것이다.)

The PPP's Party Affairs Audit Committee announced on the 19th that it had filed a complaint against Governor Woo on charges of publishing false information for the purpose of winning election under the Public Official Election Act. Governor Woo said in May that "the attraction of the largest AI data center in the country, worth 70 trillion won, has been confirmed," but recently backed down, saying it is "under discussion." This comes as the substation facilities needed to operate the data center have not been secured. (국민의힘 당무감사위원회는 19일 우 지사를 공직선거법상 당선 목적 허위 사실 공표 혐의로 고발했다고 밝혔다. 우 지사는 지난 5월 “70조원 규모 국내 최대 AI 데이터센터 유치를 확정했다”고 했지만, 최근에는 “협의 중”이라고 한 발 물러섰다. 데이터센터 가동에 필요한 변전 설비가 확보되지 않은 데 따른 것이다.)

PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said on the 15th, "This is an election pledge fraud on a different level from an ordinary withdrawal or breaking of a campaign promise," adding, "The PPP will file a complaint over Governor Woo's No. 1 pledge fraud case for violating the Public Official Election Act." PPP lawmakers from the Gangwon region also said at a press conference on the 16th, "The false announcement of successful attraction is not something that can be taken lightly in an election decided by a margin of just over 30,000 votes," adding, "It is a clear fraudulent election victory that distorted the election results by deceiving residents' eyes and ears with a false pledge." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 지난 15일 “이것은 통상적인 공약 철회나 공약 파기와는 차원이 다른 공약사기”라며 “국민의힘은 우 지사의 1호 공약 사기 사건을 공직선거법 위반으로 고발하겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘 소속 강원 지역 의원들도 16일 기자회견에서 “거짓 유치 성공 발표는 불과 3만여 표 차이로 승부가 갈린 선거에서 가볍게 넘길 수 없는 문제”라면서 “허위 공약으로 도민의 눈과 귀를 가려 선거 결과를 왜곡한 명백한 사기 당선”이라고 했다.)

Previously, conservative organizations in the Gangwon region also filed complaints against Governor Woo on the same charges. (앞서 강원 지역 보수 단체들도 우 지사를 같은 혐의로 고발했다.)
